required_practicals.RP1: Investigation into the variation of the frequency of stationary waves on a string with length, tension and mass per unit length of the string.
required_practicals.RP2: Investigation of interference effects to include the Young's slit experiment and interference by a diffraction grating.
required_practicals.RP3: Determination of g by a freefall method.
required_practicals.RP4: Determination of the Young modulus by a simple method.
required_practicals.RP5: Determination of resistivity of a wire using a micrometer, ammeter and voltmeter.
required_practicals.RP6: Investigation of the emf and internal resistance of electric cells and batteries by measuring the variation of the terminal pd of the cell with current in it.
required_practicals.RP7: Investigation into simple harmonic motion using a mass-spring system and a simple pendulum.
